//: The ACG groups the original Open webOS apps get on a Phoenix image. They predate webOS OSE's access
control groups and declare no requiredPermissions; without groups luna-hub refuses their calls.
tools/install-rootfs.py writes these into each app's client permissions
webos_app_generate_security_files does from requiredPermissions); tools/check-luna.py checks the calls
against them. The lists start from `tools/check-luna.py --suggest` (the groups OSE's api files give the
methods each app calls directly), plus database.operation and activity.operation for the apps that keep
their data in db8 and schedule activities through the frameworks (DbService, foundations' Mojo.Service),
which the checker charges to the frameworks, not the app.
